purpose: Use only already-consumed folds 0-2 to select at most one materially new Setup-shape score for later unchanged validation on untouched fold3, without rescuing the rejected V2.8.7 pure dual-compression Q5 candidate.

problem_elimination_pass.final_user_goal: Find one robust prospective Setup-shape candidate that can survive untouched validation, not optimize the rejected V2.8.7 Q5 rule.
hard_constraints: fold3 and fold4 remain completely untouched during V2.8.8 discovery
V2.8.7 Q5/Q1 result is terminal and is not reevaluated
no percentile threshold grid, weight grid, coefficient fit, optional stopping or post-result candidate edits
no Setup, First60, Episode or live authorization
soft_constraints_removed: the Setup candidate does not have to be pure dual compression
development folds do not need to be pooled into one cross-vendor panel
statistical significance on consumed development folds is not required as a promotion claim
problem_elimination_pass.architecture: Keep each consumed fold source-native, compute only signal-date-or-earlier scale-invariant features and within-date ranks, evaluate candidates independently by fold, and select by cross-fold robustness.

source_policy.source_invalid_security_handling: inherit each frozen source snapshot and its already-frozen fail-closed rules; do not repair or replace securities during discovery

feature_authority.liquidity_role: execution-only; cannot improve discovery score or create Setup eligibility
feature_authority.rank_rule: average-rank percentile within the same signal date among finite PIT-eligible securities in the same fold

candidate_library.semantic: compression inside an established medium/long trend structure
compression combined with medium-horizon continuation strength
compression while price remains structurally near its medium/long rolling highs

candidate_library_lock.reason: All three candidates add one orthogonal structural family to the replicated compression mechanism; none is a percentile rescue of the rejected V2.8.7 pure dual-compression score.

setup_shape_projection_for_discovery.within_date_candidate_rank: average-rank percentile of the frozen candidate score
setup_shape_projection_for_discovery.note: The fixed quintile projection is common to all materially different candidate scores and is not tunable during discovery.

outcomes.primary: exact D+10 same-source return: daily mean Q5 minus daily mean Q1
outcomes.secondary: exact D+5 same-source return: daily mean Q5 minus daily mean Q1
supporting: Q5 D+10 excess versus all valid securities in the same fold/date
aggregate D+10 mean by all five candidate-score quintiles

development_eligibility_requires_all: candidate has sufficient minimum information in each of folds 0, 1 and 2
mean D+10 Q5-Q1 spread is > 0 independently in each of folds 0, 1 and 2
mean D+10 Q5 excess versus all valid securities is > 0 independently in each fold
Q5 has the highest aggregate mean D+10 return among five candidate-score quintiles independently in each fold
positive valid-quarter D+10 spread share is >= 2/3 independently in each fold
every leave-one-valid-quarter-out D+10 Q5-Q1 mean spread is > 0 independently in each fold
mean D+5 Q5-Q1 spread is > 0 in at least two of the three consumed folds
no source, PIT, calendar, identity or implementation blocker

selection_rule.if_none_eligible: V2_8_8_NO_SETUP_SHAPE_SELECTED; keep fold3 and fold4 sealed
if_multiple_eligible: select the candidate with the largest minimum foldwise mean D+10 Q5-Q1 spread across folds 0-2
if tied, select the larger median foldwise mean D+10 Q5-Q1 spread
if still tied, select lexicographically smallest candidate id
selection_rule.reason: Consumed folds are for development robustness, not fresh confirmatory significance. Statistical confirmation is deferred to untouched fold3.

required_before_any_fold3_access: freeze selected candidate id and exact score formula
freeze implementation hash and deterministic self-tests
freeze fold3 manifest and source acquisition contract without reading outcomes
freeze fold3 PASS/FAIL statistics, seeds and gates
bind all prerequisite hashes in a one-time activation record

forbidden: no fold3 or fold4 price/outcome retrieval during discovery
no regression or machine-learning coefficient fitting
no adding trend, breakout, pullback or market-state conditions after seeing candidate results
no using a candidate-specific provider fallback
no re-running V2.8.7 Q5 terminal evaluation
